snippet.title: Jesus Saves - New Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
What if Jesus went to Hell to kill the Devil? 

Find out in this dark, thematic, action-platformer!

Check out our Steam page!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4601330/Jesus_Saves/

And join us on Discord for early access to the demo!
https://discord.gg/Z753PcWx3A
